🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a shadow moving wrong against the sun, the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a shadow moving wrong against the sun, the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.

📓 Journal: a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a shadow moving wrong against the sun, the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up at the door, day 7.
🎉 "OH! One more thing! We noticed some of you have been... traveling together! In little groups! How ORGANIC! How INEFFICIENT!"
"We've auto-enrolled your current traveling companions: DeAndre! You're welcome! (They can leave anytime. Probably.)"
💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.

🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."
